the solar energy can be effectively recovered and re-used in hybrid vehicles, and that the solar mild hybridization has the potential of improving the vehicle efficiency and reducing the CO2 emission.

the solar hybridization can significantly reduce the CO2 emissions of a light duty vehicle.
the solar energy flow is able to reduce the battery state of energy constraint and hence to increase the FE and reduce the CO2 emissions of a mild hybrid vehicle.
